enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Extend legs. Bend knees. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Lie still.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene routine: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take bowl and cereal from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust clothes. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Walk to door.
Leave home. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Get on bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on gloves. Check patient list. Visit patient room. Greet patient. Say 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Use stethoscope. Administer medication. Update patient records. Use computer. Attend team meeting. Talk to colleagues. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Write notes. Clock out.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Get on bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing out of work clothes and freshening up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Take off work clothes. Put work clothes in hamper. Open wardrobe. Take out casual clothes. Put on casual clothes. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Brush hair. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Cook. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and washing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Stack plates. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Scrub utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in dish rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe table with cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Press power button. Open web browser. Check email. Browse internet. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Sleep.
